text:
daniel: Quick sync — vendor wants a short tabletop this Fri 11:00am PT to walk the pen-test plan. We need to confirm two operational things before the call: 1) an RBAC change freeze window, and 2) pausing the automated KMS key rotation for the affected key so evidence snapshots remain stable. Can we lock those?

maria_sec: yes, I can lead triage and run the freeze. Prefer a 48h change freeze starting Thu 00:00 PT through Sat 00:00 PT. That gives the vendor a clear window for exploit validation.

lee_runtime: 48h freeze sounds fine. One follow-up — do we need to split read-only telemetry vs admin perms? I want to avoid blocking day-to-day observability. Suggest: deny only IAM grants, allow read-only log pulls.

maria_sec: agreed. Freeze applies only to role/grant changes. Observability reads (logs/metrics) remain allowed. I'll publish the policy snippet pre-call.

josh_infra: on KMS side I can pause the automatic rotation for key alias/ri-pt-2026 for the same 48h window. Will stage a tag so we can resume automatically after Sat 00:10 PT. Note: pausing rotation = no rotation operations, still usable for decrypt/encrypt.

olivia_oncall: will put an oncall watch for the window and escalate if anything pops. Also can take a quick playbook run-through post-call (10-15m).

pt-assessor-bot: vendor confirmed tabletop Fri 11:00am PT (Zoom invite sent). They'll focus on auth flows (service tokens), storage S3 signed URL handling, and keywrap usage for telemetry exports.

daniel: thanks. Maria — can you paste the RBAC change block you intend to push to the repo so we can review before you flip the freeze? Small example would help.

maria_sec: sure — here's the snippet I plan to apply as a pre-commit guard to the repo (just the gate):

```yaml
# repo: infra/iam/precommit.yaml
rules:
  - id: no-iam-grant-during-pt
    when: commit_time >= \"2026-03-05T00:00:00Z\" and commit_time <= \"2026-03-07T00:00:00Z\"
    action: reject
    scope: iam_changes
```

maria_sec: I'll open the PR now and tag reviewers: @lee_runtime @josh_infra @olivia_oncall.

lee_runtime: thanks. One more ask — can infra snapshot the audit logs (SF auth logs + runtime access logs) and write to an evidence bucket with object-lock enabled? That ensures timestamps are immutable for retest verification.

josh_infra: yes — plan is:
1) Snapshot CloudTrail + runtime-audit for 24h into s3://pt-evidence-2026/171712/
2) Set object-lock retention 30d (compliance mode)
3) Share presigned GETs with the vendor for read-only viewing (no PUTs)

josh_infra: sample command I will run after snapshot:
```bash
aws s3 cp /tmp/snapshot-171712.tgz s3://pt-evidence-2026/171712/ --object-lock-mode COMPLIANCE --object-lock-retain-until-date 2026-04-05T00:00:00Z
```

olivia_oncall: please post the runbook snippet for the object-lock steps so we can follow if we need to rerun.

maria_sec: adding a remediation tracker + priority column to the tracker — low-risk fixes will be fast-tracked for retest within 48h of vendor confirmation. Here's the tracker (internal): https://docs.internal.redwood/reports/pt-2026-remediation (shortlink).

daniel: good. On triage cadence: we'll do daily standups during the window at 09:30 PT and ad-hoc rolling triage as findings land. Maria, can you confirm who owns the remediation ticket lifecycle (assign->patch->test->verify->close)?

maria_sec: owners: SRE for runtime patches (lee_runtime), Infra for infra/key issues (josh_infra), App teams for product-level fixes. I'll be owner of intake + verification.

lee_runtime: small note — if vendor flags a KV cache poisoning or token replay vector that requires a hotfix, we should consider a limited canary rollout to Dedicated capacity only, to avoid impacting hosters. Put that option in the playbook.

olivia_oncall: noted. I'll add canary run instructions and rollback commands to the oncall playbook.

pt-assessor-bot: vendor asked about our KMS key policies (who can decrypt). Maria, can you confirm a short ACL statement for the vendor? They need to know the scope for their tests.

maria_sec: ACL summary: only service roles with tag "pt-access=true" and the Infra security principal can Decrypt for the key alias/ri-pt-2026. No cross-account decrypts. I'll paste the policy lines in the PR.

daniel: perfect. Last thing — retest slot booking: vendor requested retest window next Tue-Wed. We should confirm fast-track criteria (low/med/high) and ownership for each. Maria, can you draft the acceptance criteria for a "fast retest" closure?

maria_sec: draft:
- Low: config bug or missing header fix; validation by SRE within 24h; retest within 48h.
- Medium: code fix that requires canary + 1hr smoke; retest within 72h.
- High: design/security blocker — schedule formal remediation and SLA, retest per engagement (not fast-tracked).

daniel: great. I'll update the calendar invite with freeze window + runbook link and mark this thread as the single source for ops chatter. See you all Fri. :thumbsup:

olivia_oncall: I'll have oncall ready and a post-tabletop checklist to run.

josh_infra: paused rotation scheduled, will post confirmation when done.

maria_sec: PR opened: infra/iam#452 — tagging reviewers.

pt-assessor-bot: reminder: tabletop Fri 11:00am PT — zoom link in calendar.
